main_text.p: 23 Atque ita fecerunt, nempe edu-xerunt ad eum quinque illos reges de fpelunca, regem Ierusalem, regem Hebron, regem Iarmuth, regem Lachis, regem Eglon.

24 Quúmque eduxissét quinque reges illos ad Iosue, vocauit Iosue omnes viros Israel, dixítque ducibus virorum bellatorum, qui profecti erant secum, Accedite, ponite pedes vestros super colla regum istorum. Et accesserunt, posuerúntque pedes suos super colla ipsorum.
25 Tunc dixit ad eos Iosue, Ne timeatis, & ne paueatis, fortes estote, & roborate vos: sic enim faciet Iehoua omnibus inimicis vestris contra quos pugnatis.
26 Post hæc percusit eos Iosue, & interfecit eos, & suspendit in quinque lignis, fuerúntque suspensi in lignis vsque ad vesperum.

page.notes: Marginal handwritten annotations in the right margin (manuscript ink, e.g. "Reges", "Ierusalem", "Hebron", "Iarmuth", "Lachis", "Eglon", "Accedite", "Regum", "Iosue") are not printed text and are omitted. Underlining in the text is manuscript and is not reproduced as printed. Some words in the lines are slightly blurred; the transcription follows the visible letters.
